title.en: Flip-flops: clocked SR, D, JK and T
title.kn: ಫ್ಲಿಪ್-ಫ್ಲಾಪ್‌ಗಳು: ಕ್ಲಾಕ್ಡ್ SR, D, JK ಮತ್ತು T

heading.en: Change only when the clock says so

hook.en: In a computer, millions of bits must change together, in step. A clock pulse is the drumbeat; flip-flops are latches that change only on that beat.
hook.kn: ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಬಿಟ್‌ಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ, ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗಬೇಕು. ಕ್ಲಾಕ್ ಪಲ್ಸ್ ಡೋಲಿನ ಬಡಿತ; ಫ್ಲಿಪ್-ಫ್ಲಾಪ್‌ಗಳು ಆ ಬಡಿತಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬದಲಾಗುವ ಲ್ಯಾಚ್‌ಗಳು.

objectives.en: Explain the clocked SR and D flip-flops
Write the truth table and characteristic equation of the JK flip-flop
Explain race-around, the master–slave JK and the T flip-flop

narration.en: In a computer, millions of bits must change together, in step. A clock pulse is the drumbeat; flip-flops are latches that change only on that beat.
narration.kn: ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಲಕ್ಷಾಂತರ ಬಿಟ್‌ಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ, ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗಬೇಕು. ಕ್ಲಾಕ್ ಪಲ್ಸ್ ಡೋಲಿನ ಬಡಿತ; ಫ್ಲಿಪ್-ಫ್ಲಾಪ್‌ಗಳು ಆ ಬಡಿತಕ್ಕೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬದಲಾಗುವ ಲ್ಯಾಚ್‌ಗಳು.

body.en: Adding two AND (or NAND) steering gates and a clock (enable) input to an SR latch gives a clocked SR flip-flop: S and R act only while CLK = 1; when CLK = 0 the output holds. The invalid S = R = 1 case still exists. Connecting R = $\bar{S}$ through an inverter gives the D (data) flip-flop: on the clock, Q takes the value of D. It has no invalid state and is used to store data and to build registers (IC 7474: dual positive-edge-triggered D flip-flop).

points.en: Clocked SR: inputs effective only when CLK = 1
D flip-flop: Qn+1 = D, no invalid state
D flip-flop = data latch / delay element

narration.en: A clock input makes the latch respond only when the clock is active. Tie R to the complement of S and you get the D flip-flop, whose output simply copies D on the clock.
narration.kn: ಕ್ಲಾಕ್ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಸೇರಿಸಿದರೆ ಕ್ಲಾಕ್ ಸಕ್ರಿಯವಾಗಿದ್ದಾಗ ಮಾತ್ರ ಲ್ಯಾಚ್ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. R ಅನ್ನು S ನ ಪೂರಕಕ್ಕೆ ಜೋಡಿಸಿದರೆ D ಫ್ಲಿಪ್-ಫ್ಲಾಪ್: ಕ್ಲಾಕ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ Q = D.

draw.tex: JK: Q_{n+1} = J\bar Q_n + \bar K Q_n

say.en: With T equal to 1, Q toggles on every falling clock edge. Two clock cycles make one Q cycle: the frequency is halved.

text.en: T = 1: Q toggles, f becomes f/2

say.en: Race-around is cured by the master–slave flip-flop. The master listens while the clock is high; the slave copies it when the clock falls.

narration.en: On the board: JK truth table, toggling and master–slave.

title.en: JK, master–slave JK and T flip-flops

body.en: The JK flip-flop feeds Q and $\bar{Q}$ back to the input gates so that J = K = 1 is useful: the output toggles. J = K = 0 holds, J = 1, K = 0 sets and J = 0, K = 1 resets; $Q_{n+1} = J\bar{Q}_n + \bar{K}Q_n$. In a level-triggered JK with J = K = 1, if the clock pulse lasts longer than the propagation delay, the output toggles again and again: the race-around condition. It is removed by edge-triggering or by the master–slave JK (IC 7476), in which the master responds while CLK = 1 and the slave copies it when CLK goes to 0. Joining J and K as one input T gives the T (toggle) flip-flop: $Q_{n+1} = T\oplus Q_n$; with T = 1 it divides the clock frequency by 2.

points.en: Race-around: clock pulse width > propagation delay
T flip-flop: J = K = T; T = 1 → divide by 2

narration.en: The JK flip-flop removes the invalid state: J equal to K equal to 1 makes it toggle. The master-slave design stops the race-around problem, and joining J and K gives the T flip-flop that divides frequency by two.
narration.kn: JK ಫ್ಲಿಪ್-ಫ್ಲಾಪ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ J = K = 1 ಆದರೆ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಟಾಗಲ್ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಮಾಸ್ಟರ್-ಸ್ಲೇವ್ ವಿನ್ಯಾಸ ರೇಸ್-ಅರೌಂಡ್ ತಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ; J, K ಜೋಡಿಸಿದರೆ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಅರ್ಧಗೊಳಿಸುವ T ಫ್ಲಿಪ್-ಫ್ಲಾಪ್.

body.en: J = 1 makes Q jump to 1 (set), K = 1 kills Q to 0 (reset), both together flip it (toggle), and neither keeps it (hold).

narration.en: J jumps, K kills. J = 1 makes Q jump to 1 (set), K = 1 kills Q to 0 (reset), both together flip it (toggle), and neither keeps it (hold).

mnemonic.en: J sets, K kills, both flip, none keeps

problem.en: A 1 kHz square wave drives a T flip-flop with T = 1. Its output drives a second and then a third T flip-flop (T = 1). Find the output frequency of each.

steps.en: Each T flip-flop with T = 1 toggles once per clock cycle, so it halves the frequency.
